*Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) Target Action Date of March 31, 2027*


*Approval of BLA would unlock a $31 Million milestone payment from Pierre Fabre Laboratories*


*Nine-month year over year reduction in costs and operating expenses of approximately 83%*


THOUSAND OAKS, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Atara Biotherapeutics, Inc.](https://www.atarabio.com/) (Nasdaq: ATRA), a leader in T-cell immunotherapy, leveraging its novel allogeneic Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) T-cell platform to develop transformative therapies for patients with cancer and autoimmune diseases, today reported financial results for the third quarter 2026 and business updates.


“The resubmission of the tab-cel BLA was an important milestone this quarter, and we remain focused on supporting Pierre Fabre Pharmaceuticals (PFP) toward a successful outcome,” said Cokey Nguyen, President and Chief Executive Officer of Atara. “We continue to believe in tab-cel’s significant commercial potential in the U.S. In parallel, we are taking steps to control expenses with the goal of protecting and maximizing shareholder value while enhancing our strategic flexibility.”


**Tabelecleucel (tab-cel® or EBVALLO™) for Post-Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (PTLD)**


As previously communicated, the **** U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has accepted the Biologics License Application (BLA) resubmission for tabelecleucel, with a proposed indication as monotherapy for treatment of adult and pediatric patients two years of age and older with Epstein-Barr virus positive post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease (EBV+ PTLD) who have received at least one prior therapy.


The BLA has a Class 2 Resubmission Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of March 31, 2027.


If tabelecleucel is approved by the FDA, Atara would be eligible to receive a $31 million milestone payment pursuant to Atara’s commercialization agreement with Pierre Fabre Laboratories. Atara would also be eligible to receive significant double-digit tiered royalties as a percentage of net sales, as well as milestones related to commercial sales of EBVALLO.


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results:**


- Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments as of September 30, 2026, totaled $9.9 million, as compared to $9.9 million as of June 30, 2026.
- Net cash used in operating activities was $0.9 million for the third quarter 2026, as compared to $9.8 million in the same period in 2025.
- Total revenues were $1.2 million for the third quarter 2026, as compared to $3.5 million for the same period in 2025. Total revenues decreased by $2.3 million year-over-year, primarily due to the one-time sale of clinical inventory in the prior year.
- Total costs and operating expenses include non-cash stock-based compensation, depreciation and amortization expenses of $0.5 million for the third quarter 2026, as compared to $1.3 million for the same period in 2025.
- Research and development expenses were $1.1 million for the third quarter 2026, as compared to $2.9 million for the same period in 2025.
- Research and development expenses include $0.1 million of non-cash stock-based compensation expenses for the third quarter 2026, as compared to $0.3 million for the same period in 2025.
- General and administrative expenses were $2.8 million for the third quarter 2026, as compared to $4.0 million for the same period in 2025.
- General and administrative expenses include $0.4 million of non-cash stock-based compensation expenses for the third quarter 2026, as compared to $0.9 million for the same period in 2025.
- Atara reported a net loss of $2.2 million, or ($0.15) basic and diluted loss per share, for the third quarter 2026, as compared to net loss of $4.3 million, or ($0.32) basic and diluted loss per share, for the same period in 2025.


**2026 Outlook and Cash Runway:**


- Operating expenses are expected to decline significantly year-over-year, reflecting the full-year benefit of cost-reduction initiatives implemented in 2025 and the first half of 2026.
- Atara expects its cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments as of September 30, 2026, combined with operating efficiencies achieved in 2025 and the first half of 2026, will be sufficient to fund planned operations into mid-2027.


**About Atara Biotherapeutics, Inc.**


Atara is harnessing the natural power of the immune system to develop off-the-shelf cell therapies for difficult-to-treat cancers and autoimmune conditions that can be rapidly delivered to patients from inventory. With cutting-edge science and differentiated approach, Atara is the first company in the world to receive regulatory approval of an allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy. Our advanced and versatile T-cell platform does not require T-cell receptor or HLA gene editing and forms the basis of a diverse portfolio of investigational therapies that target EBV, the root cause of certain diseases. Atara is headquartered in Southern California. For more information, visit[atarabio.com](https://www.atarabio.com/) and follow[@Atarabio](https://twitter.com/atarabio) on[X](https://twitter.com/Atarabio) and[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/atarabio) .
